354103.overview: It is May 8, 1941 and you are Captain of the mighty German battleship Bismarck the single most powerful ship in the Atlantic. Hitler has given you the nearly impossible task of fighting through the British Home Fleet and sinking enough convoys to force Britain to surrender. Your level of victory will be determined by how many merchant ships and battleships you can sink. Your decisions will determine the fate of the Bismarck.

362077.overview: The time is the late 20th century. You and a neighboring country have developed a nuclear capability. Your neighbor's sole objective is to utterly annihilate you. As the tension mounts while you are conducting espionage, building bombers, missiles, submarines and anti ballistic missiles either you or your neighbor launch a pre-emptive first strike.The nuclear destruction continues until either all weapons are expended or a truce is negotiated. Victory is determined by population remaining and world political opinion which is usually against the side that started the war. If both sides lose enough people neither will win.

417624.overview:
New World is a 1 - 3 player strategy game involving colonization of the New World for multiple systems.

Starting in 1495, and proceeding in 5-year intervals, players attempt to colonize and exploit the New World. The players can choose from the European nations of England, France, or Spain, and they directly compete against the rival nations, which are either controlled by human or computer players. During each turn, the player can purchase ships, soldiers, or naval movements. Colonists can not be purchased, but can be recruited. These must be loaded onto ships, and transported to one of the many colonies in the New World.

The player can use their soldiers to battle with native tribes, and exploit gold from the new land, which must be transported back to Europe. The player also does battle with neighboring European-controlled colonies as they expand their dominion. At the end of each turn, the player receives report regarding their gold production, and transportation back to Europe. The player also receives report on maintenance costs, expenses, and colonist recruitment. Random events can complicate each turn.

417719.overview: You are a reporter, who has just been assigned to New Orleans to try to crack a heroin smuggling ring known to be operating along the waterfront. Arriving with $500, your goal is to befriend the strange denizens of nighttime New Orleans, and try to solve the case. Night Walker is an adventure game where you explore a map of the New Orleans waterfront, visiting different locations to gather clues. When the player enters a building, they go into text mode, where they can answer yes/no questions to advance the story. They can also make observations, which can be used to query other characters at a later date. There is also an inventory system, and the player can bribe characters from their limited funds. The player can enter all buildings only once, and must gather clues during this encounter. If they miss important clues, they can not reenter a building, making it essential to visit buildings in the correct order. The TRS-80 version has a 2-dimensional map represent the New Orleans waterfront, while the Commodore 64 uses a 3-dimensional display. Otherwise there are no differences between gameplay or story.

417733.overview:
Naked Nightmare is the fifth in a series of adult-oriented text adventures for the TRS-80.

The player wakes up naked and alone in a building of twisting passageways. They must escape the building before time runs out and the building explodes. The player must explore the twisting halls to find a series of buttons to deactivate a laser defense system. They can then flag down a helicopter and escape to safety. All commands are via VERB NOUN entry, and there is no save/restore option.

417905.overview:
Neutroid is a 1-player arcade game for the TRS-80.

A small neutroid bounces about a grid, and it can be redirected at any of the grid points. The goal is to crash the neutroid into the protroids that circle about the outside of the grid. If the neutroid crashes with the high energy outer wall, it is destroyed. The player advanced to the next round when all protroids are consumed. The neutroid speeds up as the round advances. Vertical and horizontal high energy regions briefly appear on the outer walls, and these supply a bonus if hit. On higher levels, bouncing antitroids can destroy a neutroid. It's game over if all neutroids are lost, and the player gains an additional neutroid every 5000 points.

462290.overview:
Night Flight is a flight simulator for multiple systems.

This program simulates the flight characteristics of the propeller-driven aircraft of World War II. The player must undertake dangerous photo-recon missions as the player guides their plane through the murky night sky, learning to take off, fly, and land relying only on instrument reading.

The player's position is shown from a 1st person perspective, but all gameplay occurs in 10 second intervals, where the player must manually select throttle, stick, and tilt settings to help guide their aircraft. The player's goal is to avoid enemy radar, and reach the location of an enemy installation to photograph the facility, land safely, and bring the photos back to command.
